reasons.text: TLS certificate is valid but issued by a free hosting CA, not by the bank's own CA.
Certificate subject CN=*.secure-idverify.top does not match the claimed brand hsbc.
Host name mixes a bank brand (hsbc) with an unrelated lookalike domain (secure-idverify.top).
Registered 6 days ago; brand domains of this age are rare.
'-internet-banking' subdomain pattern is a common phishing tactic.
Domain appears on 3 phishing blocklists (OpenPhish, PhishTank, URLhaus).
Same host was reported by 14 users in the last 24 hours.
Page posts credentials to an off-site endpoint (http://185.204.1.97/collect.php).
Login form asks for online banking username, password AND one-time code on the first screen.
Page contains an urgent 'your account will be suspended in 24h' warning.
Brand logo is loaded from an image host instead of the official site.
Form action uses plain http:// while the page is served over https (credential leak).
HSTS header missing.
